# Senchabot Extensions

> Free, open source stream overlays and tools for Twitch and Kick: Chat Box, Emote Wall, Sub Sprout, Subathon Timer, Stream Alerts, Sub Goal, Counter, Event List, End Credits, Viewer Queue, Top Supporters, Lower Thirds, Task List, Stream Frames, Stream Countdown, IRL HUD Overlay, Weather, Chat Poll, Raffle, OBS Bridge and Spin Wheel. You set one up on its web page, copy the URL and add it to OBS Studio (or another app that supports browser sources) as a Browser Source. No login and nothing to install.

Senchabot Extensions is made by Senchabot (https://senchabot.com), an open source, multi-platform community bot for Twitch, Discord, Kick and YouTube. The code is GPL-3.0 licensed at https://github.com/senchabot-opensource/monorepo (folder apps/extensions). It is not affiliated with Twitch or Kick.

Widget settings, URL parameters with defaults, and the full FAQ: [llms-full.txt](https://extensions.senchabot.com/llms-full.txt)

Every page is also in German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Portuguese and Turkish under /de, /es, /fr, /ja, /pt and /tr, for example [Chat Box in Turkish](https://extensions.senchabot.com/tr/setup/chat-widget). Overlay and tool URLs are the same in every language.

## Overlays

- [Chat Box](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/chat-widget): Twitch and Kick chat in one overlay, with 7TV emotes on both and BTTV and FFZ emotes on Twitch. Browser source size 400x600.
- [Emote Wall](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/emote-wall): Emote-only chat messages from Twitch and Kick appear as emotes on screen in Calm, Chaos, Bounce, Glide, Spin, Burst or Random mode. Browser source size 1920x1080.
- [Sub Sprout](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/sub-growing-plant): A plant that grows one stage with every new sub, resub or gifted sub on Twitch and Kick. Browser source size 800x600.
- [Stream Alerts](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/stream-alerts): An animated alert with its own sound for every sub, gifted sub, Bits, Kicks and raid on Twitch and Kick, in a Neon or a Celestial theme. Browser source size 800x450.
- [Sub Goal](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/sub-goal): A goal bar that every sub, resub and gifted sub on Twitch and Kick fills by one, with a trophy when the goal is reached. Mods fix the count with !goal. Browser source size 800x260.
- [Counter](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/counter): A count of wins, losses, jump scares or anything else, with up to four counters side by side or stacked in the picked preset's look. The broadcaster and mods change them from Twitch or Kick chat with each counter's own command, like !wins, !wins +3, !wins -1, !wins set 10 and !wins reset, and every count is saved in OBS. Browser source size 800x260, or 440x400 stacked.
- [Event List](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/event-list): A recent events list: the latest subs, resubs, gifted subs, Bits, Kicks and raids from Twitch and Kick in one list, each row marked with its platform, in the picked preset's look. Pick which events show, how many, the smallest cheers and raids that count, and whether rows fade. Mods clear it with !events clear. Browser source size 420x520.
- [End Credits](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/end-credits): Movie-style end credits: while the browser source runs, it collects everyone who subbed, gifted subs, cheered Bits or Kicks, raided, moderated or chatted on Twitch and Kick, and rolls them when its scene goes live in OBS. Mods roll it with !credits and clear it with !credits reset. Browser source size 1920x1080.
- [Top Supporters](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/top-supporters): A leaderboard: your top gifters or top Bits and Kicks givers from Twitch and Kick, or stream labels for the latest sub, gifted sub, cheer and raid. Totals keep counting until mods type !top reset. Browser source size 440x380.
- [Lower Thirds](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/lower-thirds): Animated lower thirds: a bar with your name or show title and up to 6 lines that take turns, in the picked preset's look, always up or on a timer, in any corner. No channel needed; with one, mods put up a line of their own with !lt and hide or show it. Browser source size 1920x1080.
- [Task List](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/task-list): A co-working task list for study and work streams: you and your viewers add tasks from Twitch or Kick chat with !task, tick them off with !done, change them with !edit and take them off with !remove. The broadcaster's tasks come first, a long list scrolls by itself, and mods clear it with !tasks clear. Browser source size 480x720.
- [Stream Frames](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/stream-frames): Ready-made frames for a webcam, a chat or the whole stream, drawn in the look of the picked preset, with its own shape and small animations (a temple roof and swaying tassels in Dynasty, grass blocks and flickering torches in Blocks). Transparent in the middle, no channel needed. Browser source size 640x360 (camera), 360x640 (portrait camera), 420x720 (chat) or 1920x1080 (screen).
- [Socials](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/socials): Rotate your social media links on stream with a slick slide-up animation, floating in the middle or stuck to the left or right edge, in the picked preset's look. Browser source size 600x120.
- [Stream Countdown](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/stream-countdown): A countdown for the starting soon, back soon, stream ending and pomodoro scenes. It counts down a length you set or aims at a time of day like 21:00, takes the picked preset's look, and at zero shows a message, holds 00:00 or hides itself. No channel needed; with one, mods change it with !countdown (or !cd). Browser source size 1920x1080.
- [IRL HUD Overlay](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/irl-hud): A game-style HUD for IRL streams. Subs, gifted subs, Bits, Kicks and raids on Twitch and Kick add the dollar amounts you set to a Retro or Modern cash counter, under a clock in the time zone you pick, next to a mini-map where an arrow walks a made-up city or park, or the real streets around places you save from OpenStreetMap. Mods change the cash with !hud cash, switch the mini-map with !hud map, move its arrow with !hud walk, !hud run and !hud stay, and buy market items set on the setup page with !hud buy. Browser source size 1920x1080.
- [Weather](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/weather): Live weather for any place you pick: an icon, the temperature and the weather in words, with wind, humidity and a forecast for the coming hours or days, as a card or a one-line pill, in °C or °F. The data comes free from MET Norway (CC BY 4.0, credited on the overlay), with no account or API key. No channel needed. Browser source size 1920x1080.

## Tools

- [Viewer Queue](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/viewer-queue): A viewer queue for playing with viewers: they type !join (or a join word you pick) in Twitch or Kick chat to get in line, with a note like their in-game name, and you or your mods call the next ones up with !next. Mods open, close, clear and remove with !queue. Browser source size 440x600.
- [Subathon Timer](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/subathon-timer): A subathon countdown that subs, gifted subs, Bits and Kicks add time to, shown as a health bar, a clock or a ring. Mods control it with !subathon. Browser source size 800x300.
- [Chat Poll](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/chat-poll): A poll that Twitch and Kick chat vote in by typing a number, with live bars, a timer and the winner at the end. Mods run it with !poll. Browser source size 640x560.
- [Raffle](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/raffle): Chat giveaways on Twitch or Kick. Viewers enter with a keyword like !join and you draw the winner.
- [OBS Bridge](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/obs-bridge): People you authorize switch OBS scenes and start or stop the stream and recording from Twitch or Kick chat.
- [Spin Wheel](https://extensions.senchabot.com/setup/spin-wheel): Viewers type !spin in Twitch or Kick chat and the wheel spins live in the OBS overlay, behind one global cooldown shown on screen, in the picked preset's look. Browser source size 800x800.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides): Step-by-step guides for the widgets in OBS.
- [Add a widget to OBS as a Browser Source](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/obs-browser-source): The steps, the size for each widget, and what to check when a widget looks empty.
- [Show Twitch and Kick chat together in OBS](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/twitch-kick-chat-overlay): One Chat Box URL for both chats, emotes, bot filters and a horizontal bar.
- [Run a chat giveaway on Twitch or Kick](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/chat-giveaway): Entry keyword, subscriber-only rules, win limits and the winner overlay.
- [Let mods switch OBS scenes from chat](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/obs-scene-switcher): OBS WebSocket setup, chat commands and who can use them.
- [Read Twitch and Kick chat in an OBS dock](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/obs-chat-dock): Opening the Chat Reader, adding it as an OBS dock, reconnects and chat history.
- [Add sub, cheer and raid alerts for Twitch and Kick](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/stream-alerts): Which alerts each platform gets, themes, minimum amounts and alert sound in OBS.
- [Run a subathon timer on Twitch and Kick](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/subathon-timer): Time per sub, gift, Bits and Kicks, the !subathon commands and what happens when OBS closes.
- [Run a chat poll on Twitch and Kick](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/chat-poll): The !poll commands, the ways viewers vote, one vote per viewer, stream delay and what happens when time runs out.
- [Add camera, chat and screen frames in OBS](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/stream-frames): Adding the three frame pieces, putting the frame above the camera in the source list, fitting and cropping the camera to the opening, presets and turning animations off.
- [Add a starting soon, BRB and ending countdown in OBS](https://extensions.senchabot.com/guides/stream-countdown): Setting up the starting soon, BRB, ending and pomodoro countdown scenes, making the countdown start over on every scene switch, counting down to a time of day and the !countdown commands.

## Information

- [Home](https://extensions.senchabot.com): Overview of every widget and tool.
- [Presets](https://extensions.senchabot.com/presets): Game presets (League of Legends, World of Warcraft, Metin2, Dota 2, Valorant, Counter-Strike 2, Minecraft, Clash of Clans, Fortnite, Rocket League, PUBG) that give Chat Box, Stream Alerts, Sub Goal, Subathon Timer, Chat Poll, the Raffle winner, Stream Frames, Stream Countdown, Socials and Spin Wheel the same look.
- [FAQ](https://extensions.senchabot.com/faq): Pricing, login, supported platforms, widget URLs and privacy.
- [Changelog](https://extensions.senchabot.com/changelog): New features and fixes, newest first.
